from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When set, each "*" is confined to a single path segment instead of spanning separators.
    segment_scoped: bool = False


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", segment_scoped=True),)
EOF

def matches_segments(path: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    path_segments = path.split("/")
    pattern_segments = pattern.split("/")
    if len(path_segments) != len(pattern_segments):
        return False
    return all(fnmatchcase(segment, part) for segment, part in zip(path_segments, pattern_segments))
